description: This file defines the AnnotatedClassDiscovery class, which extends a base class to implement a mechanism for discovering annotated plugins within PSR-4 namespaces in Drupal. It manages namespace and directory suffixes, constructs plugin namespace mappings, and handles annotation reading and provider extraction.

classes.name: AnnotatedClassDiscovery
classes.description: A class that discovers annotated plugins in PSR-4 namespaces, extending the base discovery class and adding namespace and directory suffix handling, annotation reading, and provider extraction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes namespace suffixes, root namespace iterator, and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: getAnnotationReader
methods.description: Retrieves and configures the annotation reader, adding the Drupal core annotation namespace.

methods.name: prepareAnnotationDefinition
methods.description: Prepares annotation definitions and sets the provider if not already set.

methods.name: getProviderFromNamespace
methods.description: Extracts the provider name from a Drupal namespace using regex.

methods.name: getPluginNamespaces
methods.description: Builds and returns the plugin namespace mappings, appending suffixes as needed.
